name: Castle Rock Dominoes
description: Castle Rock Dominoes is a western domino connecting game played on a shared layout where players match open ends and aim to shed tiles efficiently over a series of hands.

overview.description: Castle Rock Dominoes is a western domino connecting game played on a shared layout where players match open ends and aim to shed tiles efficiently over a series of hands.

history.origins: The game is encountered as a modern western domino connecting ruleset circulated through tabletop communities and rules collections.
timeline: Modern era: used as a social connecting domino format with simple matching play.
history.cultural: Played as an accessible social domino game where hand management and blocking awareness matter.
history.evolution: The rules are commonly expressed as a straightforward connecting/shedding variant on a standard set.

setup.dealing: Deal tiles according to player count; remaining tiles, if any, may form a boneyard by table preference.
setup.equipment: Dominoes and table space; optional score sheet for match play.

rules.objective: Be the first player to empty your hand, or minimize remaining pips in a blocked finish.
rules.gameplay: A starting tile opens the layout. On each turn a player places one legal matching tile to an open end. If a player cannot move, the table profile determines whether they draw from a boneyard or pass. The hand ends when a player goes out or all players are blocked.
keyRules: Tiles must match an exposed pip value at an open end of the layout.
A turn normally consists of placing one legal tile.
Blocked turns resolve via draw-or-pass handling defined by the table profile.
Hand ends on first empty hand or complete block resolution.

strategy.basic: Keep a range of pip values available so you can respond to changing ends.
strategy.intermediate: Track which values are drying up to avoid getting trapped holding dead tiles.
strategy.advanced: Control end values to reduce opponent options while preserving your own safe exits.
tips: Avoid spending highly flexible connectors too early.
In late hand, prioritize guaranteed plays over speculative end shaping.

synthesis.shortDescription: Castle Rock Dominoes is a straightforward connecting domino game on a double-6 set, focused on matching play and efficient hand shedding.
